result.stdout:
Description:
  Demeanor for .NET v6 — Code Obfuscator

Usage:
  demeanor <assembly> [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly>  Path to the .NET assembly to obfuscate.

Options:
  --out <out>                              Output directory for the obfuscated assembly.
  --include-publics                        Also obfuscate public/protected symbols. Without this 
                                           flag, publicly visible types and members in library DLLs 
                                           are preserved. Use for executables that are not 
                                           referenced by other assemblies.
  --include-deps                           Also obfuscate co-located private dependency assemblies 
                                           (transitive closure). System and third-party assemblies 
                                           are loaded for reference only.
  --names <names>                          Name generation mode: Alpha (a,b,c) or Unicode (Canadian 
                                           Aboriginal Syllabics — most systems lack the font). 
                                           [default: Alpha]
  --prefix <prefix>                        Namespace prefix for obfuscated top-level types.
  --proxy-threshold <proxy-threshold>      Minimum IL body size (bytes) for same-assembly methods 
                                           to be proxied. Default/minimum: 16. [default: 16]
  --keyfile <keyfile>                      Strong name key file (.snk) for re-signing.
  --keycontainer <keycontainer>            Strong name key container for re-signing.
  --no-serializable                        Exclude serializable types and their serializable fields.
  --exclude <exclude>                      Exclude a type or member by fully-qualified name 
                                           (repeatable).
  --xr <xr>                                Exclude types/members matching a regex pattern 
                                           (repeatable).
  --xa <xa>

Description:
  Pre-obfuscation risk analysis — detect framework patterns that break after obfuscation.

Usage:
  demeanor audit <assembly> [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly>  Path to the .NET assembly to audit.

Options:
  --include-deps       Also audit co-located private dependencies.
  --json               Output structured JSON instead of terminal table.
  --no-baml            Report WPF findings as if BAML patching is disabled (types need manual 
                       exclusion).
  --project <project>  Project root holding .demeanor/ (rules and resolved decisions). Defaults to 
                       the nearest ancestor of the assembly that contains a .demeanor directory — 
                       the same resolution an obfuscation run uses.
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information

                       renamed-fields, statistics, advisories. [default: summary]

  --limit <limit>      Maximum number of results.

Description:
  Wire automatic Release-build obfuscation into a .csproj in the current directory.

Usage:
  demeanor init [<assembly>] [options]

Arguments:
  <assembly>  Optional path to a Release build assembly. If supplied, runs an audit and prints 
              suggested exclusions before writing MSBuild integration.

Options:
  --project <project>  Path to the .csproj to wire. Skips the single-directory discovery pass 
                       entirely.
  --dry-run            Print the MSBuild snippet that would be added, but do not modify any files.
  -?, -h, --help       Show help and usage information
